scope: Actual ordinary RTX3090 opt-in, same-process complete API comparisons; all32 rows including held-out S1025/2048 and separate evaluation seed61103. Dense remains group1; causal group16 at S1024 and group4 otherwise within the existing S1024..4096 eligibility boundary.

fa2.name: fa2
fa2.layout_adapter: BHSD views to BSHD and back

published_g1_control.scope: Byte-identical published rtx3090.py loaded once under the package namespace, using the same shared runtime as the candidate; no per-call monkeypatch.

arithmetic: CuTe candidate and published-G1 control preserve rounded P/dS, actual-O delta, FP32 products and late scale. FA2 and SDPA are complete implementation comparisons; their internal operand policies are not asserted identical. Independent per-head FP64 limits are 1% BF16 and 0.5% FP16.
protocol: Same-process paired graph and synchronized eager windows; seven rotating 100-ms rounds; training forward, retained-forward backward and complete forward+backward; one-second candidate warmup; profiling separate.

qualification.original_compiler_export: All112 original compiler-returned artifact records were unavailable. Graph symbols/resources are retained; this dataset does not claim those records contain exported binaries. Later final-code binding is reported separately.

final_revalidation.sanitizer_reuse: The qualified and final source produce byte-identical PTX and cubins for all24 compilation units covering the selected training families. Existing four-tools16-case checks retain their original status; no change to device memory ownership or numerical gates. Final host-view, math, cache and graph checks were rerun.
final_revalidation.capture_recovery: The first export probe retained actual ELF images but failed its compiler-file requirement. A capture-only recovery created the compiler output directory before imports and compilation; failed reports and passed numerical checks remain retained.
